Full-Time: 		Immediate start
Job Title: 		Metal Fabricator
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a leading structural steel fabricator specialising in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects - we are seeking an experienced Metal Fabricator. The company operates a state-of-the-art facility with advanced CNC, plasma cutting, and automated welding equipment, delivering precision-engineered steelwork for high-profile builds. This role is critical to maintaining their reputation for quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Preparation & Planning
• Interpret complex blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, weld symbols, and assembly sequences.
• Conduct material take-offs and plan efficient cutting layouts to minimise waste, liaising with detailers and project managers.

Cutting & Shaping
• Operate CNC plasma cutters, oxy-fuel torches, and band saws to cut structural steel sections (beams, columns, channels) to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend metal sections and pipes using hydraulic presses, rollers, and manual methods (heating, hammering) to achieve required profiles.

Assembly & Joining
• Align and tack components using clamps, jigs, and measuring instruments (levels, squares, tape measures) to ensure dimensional accuracy.
• Join steel sections via flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), MIG, or stick welding, as well as bolting and riveting for field connections.

Finishing & Quality Control
• Inspect welds for bead width, penetration, and uniformity; perform non-destructive testing (visual, dye penetrant) as required.
• Grind, file, and polish welds and surfaces to specified finish; apply protective coatings or acid washes to prevent corrosion.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade or equivalent qualification
• Minimum 2 years' post-apprenticeship experience in metal fabrication and welding within an industrial environment
• Proficiency in reading engineering drawings and using manual/machine tools.
• Strong welding skills (FCAW/MIG) and knowledge of Australian welding standards.
• Commitment to workplace safety and quality assurance.

Essential Skills & Attributes
• Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to producing high-quality craftsmanship
• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot fabrication and welding challenges
• Physical capability to handle heavy materials and work in demanding industrial environments
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively with tradespeople and engineers
• Reliability and strong work ethic with commitment to meeting project deadlines and quality standards
• Adaptability to work across diverse projects and willingness to continuously develop technical skills

To Apply
If you are an experienced Metal Fabricator/Welder seeking a permanent role with an industry leader, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications through the application portal.

Please note: We are managing this recruitment process on behalf of our client. All applications will be reviewed by our team before being presented to the client.

result.description:
Trussmaster is a leading supplier of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames, floor systems, laminated beams and timber preservative treatment. Our supply extends from the Sunshine Coast in QLD to the South Sydney region of NSW.

For over 40 years we have developed a reputation as a dependable and low-cost supplier to some of Australia’s best-known builders.

Our competitive advantage has been established by offering efficient design, process-based quality assurance and comprehensive site support to large-scale builders and timber wholesalers. Our continued investment in leading-edge software and equipment facilitates quick and accurate quoting as well as reliable production and delivery scheduling.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join our team of hardworking professionals. In this role you will maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and install machinery and mechanical equipment. We are looking for reliable individuals with a strong commitment to positively contribute to the success of our organisation. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Conduct regular inspections, tests, and maintenance of machinery and equipment to ensure optimal operation performance
Diagnose equipment failures, analyse performance, and implement efficient solutions to machine breakdowns and minimise downtime
Prepare drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Troubleshoot mechanical issues
Install, remove, inspect, and repair mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment
Perform major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors
Disassemble, assemble, observe, repair, test, collect data and prepare reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance
Maintain non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials
Optimise mechanical efficiency by adjusting machinery and equipment settings
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation
Supports improvement projects
Fabricate and repair metal products and parts by using machine shop tools and equipment
Control downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures
Install and commission new equipment as directed
Communicate with and supporting engineers
Understand customer change request and provide schedule
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, parts usage, and system conditions in a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Skilled in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, pneumatics, and precision measuring instruments
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you have the skills and experiences we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.
